snippet.title: A Pinball Game That Makes You Mad Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The demo for A Pinball Game That Makes You Mad is coming October 6th!

You can wishlist it today with the link on my channel!

It is a Pinball rage game inspired by games like Getting Over It and Get To Work. Scale interconnected worlds, collect themes, and tackle brutal challenges in this pinball adventure!
